dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam! Are you coming? The movie starts at seven!
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm! ər juː ˈkʌmɪŋ? ðə ˈmuːvi ˈstɑːrts ət ˈsɛvən!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Hurry up! It's a quarter to seven! Is Fah coming, too?
dialogue.reading: ˈhɜːri ˈʌp! ɪts ə ˈkwɔːrtər tə ˈsɛvən! ɪz ˈfɑː ˈkʌmɪŋ, ˈtuː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, she isn't. She's going to her friend's house.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ʃiː ˈɪzənt. ʃiːz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə hɜːr ˈfrɛndz ˈhaʊs.
